title: orders.garment-job-created.v1
description: One garment of a confirmed order came into being — one of these per garment, raised inside the same confirmation as orders.order-confirmed.v1, which is what makes INV-ORD-01 expressible. The payload carries no customerId (a garment event does not need one; Reporting joins through orderId, and section 3.1 prefers projecting a personal reference away), no measurement in any form (section 5.4: never in a report, an analytical export or an integration event payload — not the values, not the template, not the version, not a count), no design selections or garment instructions (free text; the labels are on IOrderSnapshotQuery), no reference media identifiers (section 5.5, and rule 3.1.3 — media is never given a URL) and no price (Confidential). It carries no dependencies either: SQ-07 and SQ-08 in state-transitions.md section 10 are unsettled, and a frozen copy of deliver_together parcel membership would publish an undecided product rule.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the order was confirmed, in UTC. The same instant for every garment of it.

aggregateId.description: The garment job. Choosing the garment rather than the order is deliberate: every later job-scoped event uses the same aggregate, so the outbox orders creation before production, hold, resume, reschedule, ready and cancellation for that garment.

organisationId.description: The organisation the garment belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch the order was taken at, and whose workshop makes the garment.

orderId.description: The order this garment is part of.

garmentJobNumber.description: The human reference, J-<branch>-<FY>-000001-01 (docs/architecture/conventions.md section 3.2). What a tailor reads off a rack tag, and never a lookup key.

jobIndex.description: The garment's one-based position within its order.

categoryKey.description: The stitching category, by its stable key. Reporting #45 projects the pipeline and the category mix from it. The key travels and the label does not: a label is display text that may be re-worded, and IOrderSnapshotQuery carries it for anything that prints.

serviceTypeKey.description: The service type within that category, by its stable key.

workflowDefinitionId.description: The workflow this garment will be made under. Confirmation records the definition and instantiates nothing; the version is resolved and pinned at start-production (INV-JOB-02).

dueDate.description: The garment's own promised date, branch-local. The promise a workshop queue is ordered by, and the one #45 measures promised-against-actual turnaround from.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
